error: The page's population line says all orders; every figure is over delivered orders.
warning_texts: release/report.md line 3 states a population that includes all order statuses, which contradicts the report title, the claim register and audit_spec; a reader of that line would take the net revenue as covering cancelled and pending orders.

No deterministic rule in audit/check_plan.json checks the report title, the population statement or the period label, and the ISO period is excluded from surface binding in both report.md and dashboard_data.json, so this defect passed both release gates and only auditor judgment catches it.

audit/check_plan.json lists both gate_release_document rules (claims_rendered, caveats_rendered) under accepted_unproven because their proof run failed on a missing file, so the document gate's 15 PASS results were never shown to fire on a broken release.

audit_spec.yaml sets the period end to 2025-03-30 while calling it the reported quarter, and metrics/calculated_metrics.json names it 2025-Q1-delivered; the release follows the spec, but a human should confirm the end date is not meant to be 2025-03-31.
release/dashboard_data.json carries no population statement at all, only the period and per-card caveats, so the dashboard's population comes only from the 'delivered orders' caveat strings.
report.md line 11 shows the refund-rate numerator and denominator as '27 of 57' without naming the unit in that sentence; the caveat on line 10 names paying customers.
summary: All 21 shown numbers match the registry after independent recomputation and exact formatting. That covers the country sum, net = gross - refunds, the refund rate 27/57 and row accounting 201 = 174 + 26 + 1. But release/report.md line 3 tells the reader the population is all orders inside the period, while the spec population is delivered orders inside the period. No machine rule reads that line.
